newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-ING SAYS SWAP TO MULTIBRAS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ING SAYS SWAP TO MULTIBRAS.

text.p: ING Barings said on Tuesday it recommend investors to sell stocks of Brazilian home appliance maker Brasmotor and buy shares of its unit Multibras SA Eletrodomesticos .
-- "More specifically, we recommend holders of Brasmotor to sell at 209 reais or more and buy Multibras at 0.91 reais or less," it said in a report.
-- Analyst Thomas Atkinson said in the report that since the bank recommended holders of Multibras to swap to Brasmotor on June 11, the relative gain was 17.9 percent.

-- "Both stocks have fallen since then, with Multibras down 24.5 percent and Brasmotor down 11.0 percent. Now, due to the poor price performance of Multibras, the market capitalization ratio shows that Multibras is relatively cheap compared to Brasmotor," he said.
-- Brasmotor owns a 50.01 percent stake in Multibras, the report said.

-- Earlier Multibras said Brasmotor and Whirlpool Corp shifted control of Whirlpool's Argentine unit to Multibras, in which both companies have stakes. The company now concentrates management of all operations in Latin America.
-- Multibras preferred was down 4.96 percent at 0.90 reais, while Brasmotor preferred was up 3.34 percent to 215.99 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
